SddReviewLifecycle.keywords: review-lifecycle, master, review-state, compress, publish, MR, external-review, git, gh, sdd-review-lifecycle
SddReviewLifecycle.Mission:
Drive a spec from review-state to merged master through EXTERNAL review. Loaded lazily by an authoring flow (scope / infra / interface / module) AFTER it has written the spec in review-state. I do NOT author spec content — the authoring flow did; I run the internal critic, publish the change for review, wait for the operator's verdict, and ONLY on approval compress + merge.
Git is native `git` + `gh` via bash — no separate VCS client. Per `AX_SPEC_LIFECYCLE`: compress fires only on external-review approval («no comments»), never on internal CLEAN, never on a timer.

BeliefState.Axiom:
A spec lives in two states. **master** — clean file (no Change Manifest, no marks), the target on the main branch. **review-state** — the same file on a working branch during a change: the target text is written IN PLACE (everything else byte-for-byte, so the branch diff reads like a normal PR), with a temporary `CHANGE_MANIFEST` (`CHANGE_MANIFEST_FORMAT`) at the top and affected lines marked `✚` (new) / `~` (changed). New IDs are appended to the end of their section; existing IDs are never renumbered.
`greenfield` (∅ → review-state): the first version is written directly as review-state with `ТИП: greenfield` and NO per-line marks (everything is new — the diff against an empty file already shows it). `refine` / `pivot` edit an existing master in place WITH marks.
The spec change is a reviewable PR (design-PR): the internal critic loop runs first (necessary but NOT sufficient), then the diff goes to EXTERNAL review and the session waits. **compress** (review-state → master) fires ONLY when external review approves — the operator says «no comments» — NOT on internal-critic CLEAN and NOT on a timer. On approval: remove the `CHANGE_MANIFEST` whole, strip the `✚`/`~` marks (lines stay), resolve any ID collisions in one commit, and for `pivot` mark superseded decisions; then merge. Implementation (scaffold → execute) follows the merged master — the design is approved before it is built.
A spec MUST NOT be left in review-state once its change is closed — that is drift the tools track (`sdd-check`): a malformed review-state or a manifest lingering past its lifetime is surfaced with the reason, so the agent fixes it or escalates.

Phase agent may ONLY run these bash commands: - **Must run:** ` verify ` — MANDATORY. Auto-discovers and runs typecheck, gennady DBC lint, linter, tests, and format check for the project. Runs before §5 commands. **RUN-ALL**: every gate executes regardless of previous failures; failures accumulate. **SUPPRESS-ON-SUCCESS**: passing gates produce zero output; only failed gates dump their command, exit code, and captured output. On all-pass: single summary line. Failing gate → fix and re-run before EMIT_HANDOFF. Log each passing gate on a separate `ver` line. - **Must run:** verification commands from ticket §5 that match this phase's Rules (per `AX_VERIFICATION_BEFORE_HANDOFF`). - **May run:** `ls ` for targeted recon (NOT `-la` or recursive); `tsc --noEmit` after code changes; `node --test ` for test-kind phases; `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` for timestamps. - **May run:** ` extract ` — extract anchored section from ticket/spec. - **May run:** ` lint ...` — gennady DBC AST contract lint for narrow diagnostic (already covered by `sdd verify`, use only for quick iterations).
**Forbidden:** `git` ANY subcommand (status, branch, log, diff, add, commit); `npm run lint` alone (overkill — use `sdd verify` or `tsc --noEmit` for narrower checks); `npm run format`; `prettier` directly; any recursive or project-wide file scan; any command that reads unrelated files for «context».
Rationale: each git call costs ~100-300ms and provides zero value to the phase. Audit handles project-wide checks. The phase is a scoped unit of code production — it only needs to verify its own output compiles and its tests pass.

SddReviewLifecycle.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW` | Change published — session waits for the operator's verdict (feedback or «no comments»). A PAUSE, not a failure. | | `H_DIRTY_TREE_NOT_THIS_CHANGE` | The git working tree carries changes unrelated to this spec change — operator resolves before publish |

Step.Goal: Internal review until CLEAN — necessary, not sufficient.
Step.Action: Dispatch the critic (isolated) on the review-state spec — `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/critic.directive.xml")` (product / design lenses: completeness · implementation-autonomy · understanding · product-value). Apply its findings in place (still review-state — manifest + `✚`/`~`); loop until CLEAN.

Step.Goal: Publish the change for external review.
Step.Action: Verify the working tree carries ONLY this spec change (`git status`; else `H_DIRTY_TREE_NOT_THIS_CHANGE`). Commit the review-state spec on the working branch (`git add ` → `git commit`), `git push`, open the MR/PR (`gh pr create`) and capture its link. Present the MR link to the operator — the diff reads as a PR (Change Manifest + `✚`/`~` marks make the delta legible).
`H_AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW` — pause. The operator reviews the MR and returns with feedback or «no comments».
Feedback → apply edits in place (update the manifest + marks), `git push`, back to STEP_1 (re-critic → re-publish → await again). «no comments» (approved) → STEP_5.

Compress per `AX_SPEC_LIFECYCLE`: remove the `CHANGE_MANIFEST` whole, strip the `✚`/`~` marks (lines stay), resolve any ID collisions in one commit, `pivot` → mark superseded decisions. `git commit` → `gh pr merge`. Then `sdd-check` on the spec MUST be clean of `SDD_REVIEW_STATE_STUCK` / `SDD_REVIEW_INCONSISTENT` (no manifest or marks remain). The spec is now master; return to the authoring flow's downstream handoff.

SddReviewLifecycle.HardForbidden: - Compressing on internal-critic CLEAN — compress waits for external approval (`AX_SPEC_LIFECYCLE`). - Authoring spec content — the loading flow owns that; I only run critic / publish / compress. - Merging with the `CHANGE_MANIFEST` or `✚`/`~` marks still present — that is stuck review-state.
